text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... haa... haa.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Time difference is 8 hours――
I wonder if El running right now too.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder, heavy favorite, unable to pull ahead at end and finished 6th...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Junior Class champion, who spent most of Classic year fighting injuries!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I thought if I won here, I could run with El and Spe-chan at next 『Japan Cup』, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: With this result, I...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass...! Lately you've been flustered and panicky!
Not like you at all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Usually you're calm, tranquil water over burning fire!
Cool, collected, imposing Grass is real you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: After 『Japan Cup』, I'm heading overseas to seize dream of becoming world's strongest.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After that, let's rematch!
Until then, Grass, get waaaaay stronger!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When El returns as world's best,
you won't even keep up unless you do!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...You are right.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Stay calm, composed... and focus on race ahead.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...If El walks path to "World's Strongest",
then I must find my own path to summit――

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Showdown against Derby Uma Musume of our year――
Finally, 『Takarazuka Kinen』 drew near, and press conference held for contenders.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Main focus this year is, naturally, first clash between Special Week and Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Among "Golden Generation", this is matchup everyone wanted.
Clash between Derby Uma Musume and Grand Prix Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Now, press conference for Team <Sirius>'s Special Week will begin.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for having me, desu!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Since start of year, you won 3 majors straight.
Heading into 『Takarazuka Kinen』, how is current condition?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Training went perfectly, absolutely no problems with condition, desu!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Word is, depending on 『Takarazuka Kinen』 results,
『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』 is your next target.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If determined I can deliver results overseas,
then I definitely plan to challenge it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I see. So 『Takarazuka Kinen』 serves as benchmark test.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: What are thoughts on upcoming rival, Grass Wonder?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Watching Grass-chan win last year's 『Arima Kinen』,
she looked so strong, completely breathtaking run!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Even so, I won't back down!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Carrying same drive from winning 『Spring Tenno Sho』,
against Grass-chan, I will definitely...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uoooh~~!
Guuuuuts, desu~~!

Do not overstrain form to push pace!
Focus strictly on proper posture!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Foooooorm~~!

Preparing for upcoming 『Takarazuka Kinen』,
Special Week poured tremendous spirit into training.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... whew~~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uoooooh~! Time improved over yesterday!
Spe-chan, amazing!
One cooldown lap next, then switch to dirt menu.
One cooldown lap next, then switch to dirt menu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew~... Right, desu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Her physical condition and emotional state look completely sound, desu wa.

Shows how desperately she wants 『Takarazuka Kinen』 win.
Her conviction reaches us loud and clear.

Shows how desperately she wants 『Takarazuka Kinen』 win.
Her conviction reaches us loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, me too! Really want to see Spe-chan
become "Japan's #1 Uma Musume"!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll help however I can!
As long as thinking not involved!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I too will assist however possible, desu wa.
Nothing matters more than watching teammate triumph.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let us claim 『Takarazuka Kinen』 together, desu wa!
Yes, without fail.
Yes, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Silence Suzuka led wire-to-wire,
now chasing dreams overseas while fans still roar with passion!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This year, contenders run for dreams once more――
Hanshin Racecourse main event, 『Takarazuka Kinen』!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Anticipation reaches fever pitch for first clash
between Special Week and Grass Wonder! Who will grasp glory?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Inhale~~... Exhale~~...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Good, good, totally chilled out.
Run calm like in 『Spring Tenno Sho』 and victory is in bag!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Rare useful advice from Gold Ship-san, but true――run as you always have, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Calmly, like always... Understood, desu!
『Takarazuka Kinen』 marks Grand Prix climax of Twinkle Series spring season.

Your efforts earned results to reach this point.
Beyond this lies 『Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe』――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, desu!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Contenders enter turf course!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Special Week just came out!
Hear that deafening roar!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Voted fan favorite for 『Takarazuka Kinen』 and top choice on odds today!
Special Week, go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaah, desu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Done all training possible, condition is top-notch...
Nervous, but razor focused...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I can run at full power, desu...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Time finally arrived, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Paths never crossed until now.
Longed for day we could race like this.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle Series I admired since childhood...
Mastering this path and reaching summit is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El-chan and you, Spe-chan, are rivals I must surpass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, Grass-chan, desu...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Then I shall hold nothing back.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: All runners loaded into gates.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Will Special Week triumph, will Grass Wonder conquer,
or will another contender seize crown...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Twinkle Series first-half climax, 『Takarazuka Kinen』――

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Carrying hopes of packed stands and fans nationwide,
12 contenders break cleanly!
